passages.text: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying, “You must not marry or have sons or daughters in this place.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to me.
He gave me a command.
He said, “Do not marry a wife in this place.
Do not have sons or daughters here.”
passages.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃ לֹֽא־ תִקַּ֥ח לְךָ֖ אִשָּׁ֑ה וְלֹֽא־ יִהְי֤וּ לְךָ֙ בָּנִ֣ים וּבָנ֔וֹת בַּמָּק֖וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃

passages.text: For this is what the LORD says concerning the sons and daughters born in this place, and the mothers who bore them, and the fathers who fathered them in this land: “They will die from deadly diseases. They will not be mourned or buried, but will lie like dung on the ground. They will be finished off by sword and famine, and their corpses will become food for the birds of the air and beasts of the earth.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks about the people in this land.
He speaks about the sons and daughters born here.
He speaks about their mothers who give birth to them.
He speaks about their fathers who father them in this land.
These children and parents will die from deadly diseases.
No one will mourn for them.
No one will bury them.
Their bodies will lie on the ground like dung.
They will die by the sword.
They will die by famine.
Birds of the sky will eat their corpses.
Beasts of the earth will eat their corpses.
passages.original: כִּי־ כֹ֣ה׀ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה עַל־ הַבָּנִים֙ וְעַל־ הַבָּנ֔וֹת הַיִּלּוֹדִ֖ים בַּמָּק֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה וְעַֽל־ אִמֹּתָ֞ם הַיֹּלְד֣וֹת אוֹתָ֗ם וְעַל־ אֲבוֹתָ֛ם הַמּוֹלִדִ֥ים אוֹתָ֖ם בָּאָ֥רֶץ הַזֹּֽאת׃ מְמוֹתֵ֨י תַחֲלֻאִ֜ים יָמֻ֗תוּ לֹ֤א יִסָּֽפְדוּ֙ וְלֹ֣א יִקָּבֵ֔רוּ לְדֹ֛מֶן עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י הָאֲדָמָ֖ה יִֽהְי֑וּ וּבַחֶ֤רֶב וּבָֽרָעָב֙ יִכְל֔וּ וְהָיְתָ֤ה נִבְלָתָם֙ לְמַאֲכָ֔ל לְע֥וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם וּלְבֶהֱמַ֥ת הָאָֽרֶץ׃ס

passages.text: Indeed, this is what the LORD says: “Do not enter a house where there is a funeral meal. Do not go to mourn or show sympathy, for I have removed from this people My peace, My loving devotion, and My compassion,” declares the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to me.
The LORD gave me a command.
The LORD said, “Do not enter a house where there is a funeral meal.
Do not go to mourn for the dead.
Do not show sympathy to them.
I have taken away My peace from these people.
I have removed My loving devotion from them.
I have removed My compassion from them.
I, the LORD, declare this.”
passages.original: כִּֽי־ כֹ֣ה׀ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה אַל־ תָּבוֹא֙ בֵּ֣ית מַרְזֵ֔חַ וְאַל־ תֵּלֵ֣ךְ לִסְפּ֔וֹד וְאַל־ תָּנֹ֖ד לָהֶ֑ם כִּֽי־ אָסַ֨פְתִּי אֶת־ שְׁלוֹמִ֜י מֵאֵ֨ת הָעָ֤ם־ הַזֶּה֙ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה אֶת־ הַחֶ֖סֶד וְאֶת־ הָֽרַחֲמִֽים׃

passages.text: “Both great and small will die in this land. They will not be buried or mourned, nor will anyone cut himself or shave his head for them.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks about the people in this land.
Both important people and unimportant people will die here.
No one will bury them.
No one will mourn for them.
No one will cut himself for them.
No one will shave his head for them.
passages.original: וּמֵ֨תוּ גְדֹלִ֧ים וּקְטַנִּ֛ים בָּאָ֥רֶץ הַזֹּ֖את לֹ֣א יִקָּבֵ֑רוּ וְלֹֽא־ יִסְפְּד֣וּ לָהֶ֔ם וְלֹ֣א יִתְגֹּדַ֔ד וְלֹ֥א יִקָּרֵ֖חַ לָהֶֽם׃

passages.text: No food will be offered to comfort those who mourn the dead; not even a cup of consolation will be given for the loss of a father or mother.
passages.sermon:
The LORD has removed His peace, loving devotion, and compassion from this people.
No one will offer food to comfort those who mourn the dead.
No one will give a cup of consolation to someone who has lost a father.
No one will give a cup of consolation to someone who has lost a mother.
passages.original: וְלֹֽא־ יִפְרְס֥וּ לָהֶ֛ם עַל־ אֵ֖בֶל לְנַחֲמ֣וֹ עַל־ מֵ֑ת וְלֹֽא־ יַשְׁק֤וּ אוֹתָם֙ כּ֣וֹס תַּנְחוּמִ֔ים עַל־ אָבִ֖יו וְעַל־ אִמּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: You must not enter a house where there is feasting and sit down with them to eat and drink.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to Jeremiah.
God gives a command.
Do not enter a house where people are feasting.
Do not sit with them.
Do not eat with them.
Do not drink with them.
passages.original: וּבֵית־ מִשְׁתֶּ֥ה לֹא־ תָב֖וֹא לָשֶׁ֣בֶת אוֹתָ֑ם לֶאֱכֹ֖ל וְלִשְׁתּֽוֹת׃ס

passages.text: For this is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: I am going to remove from this place, before your very eyes and in your days, the sounds of joy and gladness, the voices of the bride and bridegroom.
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts is the God of Israel.
He speaks these words.
He says, "I will act now."
I will take away something from this place.
I will do this while you are alive.
You will see it with your own eyes.
I will remove the sound of joy from here.
I will remove the sound of gladness from here.
I will silence the voice of the bridegroom.
I will silence the voice of the bride.
There will be no more celebration here.
passages.original: כִּי֩ כֹ֨ה אָמַ֜ר יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הִנְנִ֨י מַשְׁבִּ֜ית מִן־ הַמָּק֥וֹם הַזֶּ֛ה לְעֵינֵיכֶ֖ם וּבִֽימֵיכֶ֑ם ק֤וֹל שָׂשׂוֹן֙ וְק֣וֹל שִׂמְחָ֔ה ק֥וֹל חָתָ֖ן וְק֥וֹל כַּלָּֽה׃

passages.text: When you tell these people all these things, they will ask you, ‘Why has the LORD pronounced all this great disaster against us? What is our guilt? What is the sin that we have committed against the LORD our God?’
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD.
God is the God of Israel.
God has spoken to the people through His prophet.
You will tell the people everything God has said.
The people will hear all these words.
The people will ask you a question.
They will say, “Why has the LORD spoken all this great disaster against us?”
They will ask, “What is our guilt?”
They will ask, “What is the sin we have committed against the LORD our God?”
passages.original: וְהָיָ֗ה כִּ֤י תַגִּיד֙ לָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה אֵ֥ת כָּל־ הַדְּבָרִ֖ים הָאֵ֑לֶּה וְאָמְר֣וּ אֵלֶ֗יךָ עַל־ מֶה֩ דִבֶּ֨ר יְהוָ֤ה עָלֵ֙ינוּ֙ אֵ֣ת כָּל־ הָרָעָ֤ה הַגְּדוֹלָה֙ הַזֹּ֔את וּמֶ֤ה עֲוֺנֵ֙נוּ֙ וּמֶ֣ה חַטָּאתֵ֔נוּ אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָטָ֖אנוּ לַֽיהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃

passages.text: Then you are to answer them: ‘It is because your fathers have forsaken Me, declares the LORD, and followed other gods, and served and worshiped them. They abandoned Me and did not keep My instruction.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD declares this message.
Your fathers abandoned Me.
They followed other gods.
They served those other gods.
They worshiped those other gods.
They left Me.
They did not keep My instruction.
passages.original: וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵיהֶ֗ם עַל֩ אֲשֶׁר־ עָזְב֨וּ אֲבוֹתֵיכֶ֤ם אוֹתִי֙ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה וַיֵּלְכ֗וּ אַֽחֲרֵי֙ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וַיַּעַבְד֖וּם וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲו֣וּ לָהֶ֑ם וְאֹתִ֣י עָזָ֔בוּ וְאֶת־ תּוֹרָתִ֖י לֹ֥א שָׁמָֽרוּ׃

passages.text: And you have done more evil than your fathers. See how each of you follows the stubbornness of his evil heart instead of obeying Me.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the people of Israel.
You have done more evil than your fathers.
Each of you follows the stubbornness of his own evil heart.
You do not obey Me.
passages.original: וְאַתֶּ֛ם הֲרֵעֹתֶ֥ם לַעֲשׂ֖וֹת מֵאֲבֽוֹתֵיכֶ֑ם וְהִנְּכֶ֣ם הֹלְכִ֗ים אִ֚ישׁ אַֽחֲרֵי֙ שְׁרִר֣וּת לִבּֽוֹ־ הָרָ֔ע לְבִלְתִּ֖י שְׁמֹ֥עַ אֵלָֽי׃

passages.text: So I will cast you out of this land into a land that neither you nor your fathers have known. There you will serve other gods day and night, for I will show you no favor.’
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks to the people of Israel.
He says, "I will cast you out of this land."
You will go to a land that you do not know.
Your fathers did not know this land either.
There, you will serve other gods.
You will serve them day and night.
I will not show you any favor there.
passages.original: וְהֵטַלְתִּ֣י אֶתְכֶ֗ם מֵעַל֙ הָאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּ֔את עַל־ הָאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר֙ לֹ֣א יְדַעְתֶּ֔ם אַתֶּ֖ם וַאֲבֽוֹתֵיכֶ֑ם וַעֲבַדְתֶּם־ שָׁ֞ם אֶת־ אֱלֹהִ֤ים אֲחֵרִים֙ יוֹמָ֣ם וָלַ֔יְלָה אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹֽא־ אֶתֵּ֥ן לָכֶ֖ם חֲנִינָֽה׃ס

passages.text: Yet behold, the days are coming, declares the LORD, when they will no longer say, ‘As surely as the LORD lives, who brought the Israelites up out of the land of Egypt.’
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks to the people of Israel.
He says, “Behold, days are coming.”
The LORD declares this truth.
In those days, people will not say, ‘As surely as the LORD lives, who brought the Israelites out of Egypt.’
They will stop using this saying about the LORD’s deliverance from Egypt.
passages.original: לָכֵ֛ן הִנֵּֽה־ יָמִ֥ים בָּאִ֖ים נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֑ה וְלֹֽא־ יֵאָמֵ֥ר עוֹד֙ חַי־ יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֧ר הֶעֱלָ֛ה אֶת־ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃

passages.text: Instead they will say, ‘As surely as the LORD lives, who brought the Israelites up out of the land of the north and all the other lands to which He had banished them.’ For I will return them to their land that I gave to their forefathers.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD lives.
The LORD brought the Israelites out of the land of the north.
The LORD also brought the Israelites out of all the other lands where He had banished them.
The LORD will return the Israelites to their own land.
The LORD gave this land to their forefathers.
passages.original: כִּ֣י אִם־ חַי־ יְהוָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֶעֱלָ֜ה אֶת־ בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ צָפ֔וֹן וּמִכֹּל֙ הָֽאֲרָצ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִדִּיחָ֖ם שָׁ֑מָּה וַהֲשִֽׁבֹתִים֙ עַל־ אַדְמָתָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לַאֲבוֹתָֽם׃ס

passages.text: But for now I will send for many fishermen, declares the LORD, and they will catch them. After that I will send for many hunters, and they will hunt them down on every mountain and hill, even from the clefts of the rocks.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks.
The LORD says He will act now.
The LORD will send many fishermen.
The fishermen will catch the people.
After this, the LORD will send many hunters.
The hunters will hunt the people.
They will search on every mountain.
They will search on every hill.
They will search even in the clefts of the rocks.
passages.original: הִנְנִ֨י שֹׁלֵ֜חַ לְדַוָּגִים רַבִּ֛ים נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֖ה וְדִיג֑וּם וְאַֽחֲרֵי־ כֵ֗ן אֶשְׁלַח֙ לְרַבִּ֣ים צַיָּדִ֔ים וְצָד֞וּם מֵעַ֤ל כָּל־ הַר֙ וּמֵעַ֣ל כָּל־ גִּבְעָ֔ה וּמִנְּקִיקֵ֖י הַסְּלָעִֽים׃

passages.text: For My eyes are on all their ways. They are not hidden from My face, and their guilt is not concealed from My eyes.
passages.sermon:
The LORD sees everything people do.
His eyes watch all their ways.
Nothing is hidden from Him.
No one can conceal their actions from His sight.
Their guilt is always visible to Him.
He does not overlook their sin.
passages.original: כִּ֤י עֵינַי֙ עַל־ כָּל־ דַּרְכֵיהֶ֔ם לֹ֥א נִסְתְּר֖וּ מִלְּפָנָ֑י וְלֹֽא־ נִצְפַּ֥ן עֲוֺנָ֖ם מִנֶּ֥גֶד עֵינָֽי׃

passages.text: And I will first repay them double their iniquity and their sin, because they have defiled My land with the carcasses of their detestable idols, and they have filled My inheritance with their abominations.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks.
The LORD will act first.
The LORD will repay the people.
He will repay them double for their iniquity and their sin.
They have defiled the LORD’s land.
They did this with the dead bodies of their detestable idols.
They have filled the LORD’s inheritance with their abominations.
passages.original: וְשִׁלַּמְתִּ֣י רִֽאשׁוֹנָ֗ה מִשְׁנֵ֤ה עֲוֺנָם֙ וְחַטָּאתָ֔ם עַ֖ל חַלְּלָ֣ם אֶת־ אַרְצִ֑י בְּנִבְלַ֤ת שִׁקּֽוּצֵיהֶם֙ וְתוֹעֲב֣וֹתֵיהֶ֔ם מָלְא֖וּ אֶת־ נַחֲלָתִֽי׃ס

passages.text: O LORD, my strength and my fortress, my refuge in the day of distress, the nations will come to You from the ends of the earth, and they will say, “Our fathers inherited nothing but lies, worthless idols of no benefit at all.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is my strength.
The LORD is my fortress.
The LORD is my refuge in times of trouble.
Nations will come to the LORD.
They will come from the ends of the earth.
They will say, “Our fathers inherited lies.
Our fathers inherited worthless idols.
These idols do not help at all.”
passages.original: יְהוָ֞ה עֻזִּ֧י וּמָעֻזִּ֛י וּמְנוּסִ֖י בְּי֣וֹם צָרָ֑ה אֵלֶ֗יךָ גּוֹיִ֤ם יָבֹ֙אוּ֙ מֵֽאַפְסֵי־ אָ֔רֶץ וְיֹאמְר֗וּ אַךְ־ שֶׁ֙קֶר֙ נָחֲל֣וּ אֲבוֹתֵ֔ינוּ הֶ֖בֶל וְאֵֽין־ בָּ֥ם מוֹעִֽיל׃

passages.text: Can man make gods for himself? Such are not gods!”
passages.sermon: A man can try to make gods for himself.\r\nThese things are not truly gods.
passages.original: הֲיַעֲשֶׂה־ לּ֥וֹ אָדָ֖ם אֱלֹהִ֑ים וְהֵ֖מָּה לֹ֥א אֱלֹהִֽים׃

passages.text: “Therefore behold, I will inform them, and this time I will make them know My power and My might; then they will know that My name is the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is speaking.
The LORD says, "Therefore, I will inform them now."
This time, I will show them My power.
I will show them My might.
They will know that My name is the LORD.
passages.original: לָכֵן֙ הִנְנִ֣י מֽוֹדִיעָ֔ם בַּפַּ֣עַם הַזֹּ֔את אוֹדִיעֵ֥ם אֶת־ יָדִ֖י וְאֶת־ גְּבֽוּרָתִ֑י וְיָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי־ שְׁמִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃ס
